title: JSFL fl.getTimer() not implemented — throws TypeError
description: fl.getTimer() is missing from both the JsflFl TypeScript interface and the makeFlProxy implementation in packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts. Any JSFL script calling fl.getTimer() throws TypeError: fl.getTimer is not a function. Flash 8 JSFL defines fl.getTimer() to return milliseconds elapsed since IDE start — a common pattern for timing loops. Fix: capture _startTime = Date.now() at top of makeFlProxy, add getTimer(): number to the JsflFl interface, and implement it as Date.now() - _startTime in the returned proxy object.
